subject.title: fix(agents): finalize killed subagent task rows via maintenance to avoid kill-vs-complete race

question: Should this PR be rebased to add maintenance-side cleanup on top of current main's provisional-cancel kill model, or retired because merged/current follow-up work now owns the remaining behavior?
rationale: Current main changed the same session-state contract after this branch was written, and automation cannot safely choose whether `lost -> succeeded` should remain the permanent reconciliation rule.

options.title: Rebase Maintenance Repair
options.body: Adapt the terminal-run maintenance sweep to current provisional-kill semantics, keep focused tests for historical stuck rows and CLI peers, and update docs for any retained terminal-state exception.

options.title: Accept Lost-To-Succeeded Semantics
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly keep the PR's `lost -> succeeded` rule, but should document it and verify the merge result against current main's provisional cancellation behavior.

options.title: Retire As Superseded
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99806 plus the open cancellation follow-up are considered sufficient, close this branch manually and keep any residual maintenance cleanup in a narrower item.

recommendation.title: Rebase Maintenance Repair
recommendation.body: Adapt the terminal-run maintenance sweep to current provisional-kill semantics, keep focused tests for historical stuck rows and CLI peers, and update docs for any retained terminal-state exception.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main repair defines the provisional-kill semantics this branch now has to integrate with or defer to.
